main_text.l: [woodcut illustration of a cask with burst hoops, no text]
SOluuntur compacta licet bene dolia, firmis-

page.notes: The woodcut shows a barrel with hoops split away, lying on the ground. The verse is set in italic type; the initial S is a large woodcut letter. The page number 118 is printed at top right, shown as "118" in the scan (printed as iiß / 118). Verse lines are copied as printed.
